user_intent.original_question: 查询职业生涯跨度（从第一部到最后一部作品的年数）最长的前 10 位演员，显示演员名和职业生涯跨度年数

metrics.name: 职业生涯跨度
metrics.note: 仅统计有 start_year 的作品

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 高产演员分析（含多面手得分）
historical_qa_pairs.sql: SELECT n.primary_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.title_id) AS movie_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_movie_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS role_diversity, MIN(t.start_year) AS first_movie_year, MAX(t.start_year) AS last_movie_year, MAX(t.start_year) - MIN(t.start_year) AS career_span FROM names n JOIN principals p ON p.name_id = n.id JOIN titles t ON t.id = p.title_id WHERE p.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') AND t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.average_rating > 7.0 AND t.num_votes > 10000 AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.id, n.primary_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.title_id) >= 10 ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 20

knowledge.content: 查询演员必须同时包含 category_id IN ('actor', 'actress')
Career Span = MAX(t.start_year) - MIN(t.start_year)，仅统计有 start_year 的作品
